title: Corrected QT Interval (QTc)
sources: Rautaharju PM et al. AHA/ACCF/HRS. Circulation 2009;119:e241-50

changelog.change: Tier 1 verification: formulas confirmed. Added a Fridericia interpretation band set; borderline band now starts at 450 ms (men) per AHA/ACCF/HRS 2009.

purpose: Checked before/after any QT-prolonging drug (ondansetron, droperidol, haloperidol, methadone, antipsychotics) — directly changes med choice.

interpretation.label: Prolonged — review QT-prolonging meds, correct K⁺ / Mg²⁺ / Ca²⁺
Markedly prolonged — high torsades risk; avoid adding QT-prolonging drugs
Prolonged — review QT-prolonging meds and electrolytes

notes: AHA/ACCF/HRS 2009: 'prolonged' ≥ 450 ms (men) / ≥ 460 ms (women); 'markedly abnormal' ≥ 500 ms. Fridericia is more accurate at extremes of heart rate — prefer it for HR < 60 or > 100. Bazett over-corrects at high HR and under-corrects at low HR.
buildNote: Formula engine. Fridericia uses a cube root — verify the app's expression evaluator supports cbrt().
